title: SOMA Auth: enable GitHub sign-in
_note: Run sign-in.guide.json first if Supabase is signed out. Pass --param CLIENT_ID=<GitHub app Client ID>. The secret is never prefilled or read.

steps.instruction: Turn on GitHub enabled (the first switch at the top of this panel).
Paste the client secret from your clipboard into Client Secret.
Yeshie filled in the Client ID from your GitHub app (it starts Ov23li2k). Check it matches the GitHub tab, leave Allow users without an email off, then click Save.
